title: External biological-context validation on independent glioma brain-slice tracking data

relationship_to_stage_e.purpose: supplementary external validation only; no retrospective rescue or retuning of Stage E

primary_source.dataset_title: Comparative dynamics of microglial and glioma cell motility at the infiltrative margin of brain tumours
primary_source.preparation: living acute brain slices at the infiltrative tumour margin
primary_source.reference_tracking: manual frame-by-frame single-cell tracking reported by the source study
primary_source.target_population_for_this_project: glioma/tumour cells only; microglia are not the primary validation population

allowed_before_freeze: inspect archive/file names and data schemas
identify coordinate columns, frame/time columns, cell-type labels and physical units
verify row counts, missingness and coordinate/unit consistency without computing method-performance metrics
forbidden_before_freeze: choose exclusions based on method performance
tune distance, calibration or posterior thresholds against external outcomes
select a favourable experiment as the confirmatory test
pre_outcome_ingestion_rule.freeze_requirement: Commit the source manifest, parser, unit conversion, inclusion/exclusion rules and evaluation code before computing confirmatory method comparisons.

analysis_design.biological_replication_rule: The experiment is the biological replicate. Cells/tracks are nested observations and must not be counted as independent biological replicates.
analysis_design.preferred_design: frozen Stage E method applied without parameter fitting to all three experiments

fallback_if_format_specific_adaptation_i.development_experiment: preselect one experiment by stable source identifier before outcomes are computed
fallback_if_format_specific_adaptation_i.rule: parser/unit adaptation only on the development experiment; no model/calibration/threshold fitting on confirmatory experiments

analysis_design.pooling_rule: Never report pooled cells/tracks as biological n.

primary_endpoints_if_link_ground_truth_i.name: association_error_auprc
primary_endpoints_if_link_ground_truth_i.comparison: frozen calibrated uncertainty versus registered distance confidence

primary_endpoints_if_link_ground_truth_i.name: selective_link_risk_at_80_percent_coverage
primary_endpoints_if_link_ground_truth_i.comparison: selective calibrated uncertainty versus full coverage

primary_endpoints_if_link_ground_truth_i.name: link_f1
primary_endpoints_if_link_ground_truth_i.comparison: uncertainty-compatible frozen links versus hard nearest-neighbour links

statistical_plan.confidence_interval: 95 percent hierarchical/cluster bootstrap where experiment is the top-level biological unit and tracks are resampled only within experiment
statistical_plan.small_n_warning: With only three experiments, intervals and experiment-level contrasts are descriptive/sensitivity evidence and must not be presented as precise population-level inference.
statistical_plan.effect_reporting: Report signed paired effect sizes and confidence intervals; do not rely on p-values as the primary interpretation.

success_interpretation.allowed: Evidence that the frozen uncertainty-aware tracking methodology transfers technically to an independent rat glioma brain-slice context.
not_allowed: retrospective conversion of Stage E REVISE to GO

stop_conditions: Deposited tracking data cannot be mapped unambiguously to time-resolved tumour-cell trajectories.
Source files do not permit independent reconstruction of the registered endpoints.
Biological experiment identity cannot be preserved.
Required preprocessing would need outcome-guided manual choices.
Reference labels are derived from the same frozen method being evaluated.
reporting: Report every eligible experiment, including negative results.
Report exact biological n separately from track/cell counts.
Keep technical uncertainty and biological inference explicitly separated.
Preserve the Stage E locked result unchanged.
